faq.question: How long does an average bathroom renovation take?
faq.answer: A complete bathroom renovation takes an average of 2 to 3 weeks, depending on the complexity and the materials chosen.

faq.question: Can I stay in my home during the renovation?
faq.answer: Yes, that's usually possible. We make sure disruption is kept to a minimum and keep the work area clean every day.

faq.question: Do you also take care of construction waste removal?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We arrange the containers and the complete removal of rubble and old sanitary ware, so you don't have to worry about a thing.

faq.question: Do I need to buy materials myself?
faq.answer: You can, but you don't have to. We have good contacts with suppliers and can arrange everything for you at favorable rates.

faq.question: Do you work with fixed prices?
faq.answer: We work based on a detailed quote. That way you know exactly where you stand in advance, with no surprises afterwards.

faq.question: Is there a warranty on the work carried out?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer a standard warranty on all our craftsmanship. The specific terms depend on the type of work and the materials used.
